definitions: David Saul Marshall (1908-1995) was a Singaporean politician and lawyer who served as the first Chief Minister of Singapore from 1955 to 1956.
David Marshall is a common name for individuals, and can refer to various people across different fields such as sports, arts, or academia.
examples: David Marshall played a pivotal role in Singapore's journey to self-governance.
The new exhibition features works by artist David Marshall.
Professor David Marshall presented his research findings.
